disclaimer: Informational triage only. Not legal advice. Verify against the official text and consult qualified counsel.
source_note: Reflects Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as amended by the Digital Omnibus political agreement of 7 May 2026. Deadlines for Annex III high-risk systems were deferred; verify the final adopted text.

prohibited.label: Prohibited / Unacceptable risk
prohibited.summary: Banned outright. These practices may not be placed on the market, put into service, or used in the EU.

high.label: High-risk
high.summary: Permitted but subject to the heaviest obligations (risk management, data governance, logging, human oversight, conformity assessment, registration).

deadlines.note: Annex III (use-based) deferred from 2026-08-02 to 2027-12-02 by the Digital Omnibus agreement; Annex I (product-embedded) deferred to 2028-08-02. Penalties framework otherwise applies from 2026-08-02.

limited.label: Limited risk
limited.summary: Transparency obligations only: disclose AI interaction, label AI-generated/synthetic content and deepfakes.

minimal.label: Minimal risk
minimal.summary: No mandatory obligations under the Act. Voluntary codes of conduct encouraged.

prohibited_practices.test: subliminal, manipulative or deceptive techniques that materially distort behaviour causing harm
exploiting vulnerabilities due to age, disability, or socio-economic situation
social scoring of individuals leading to detrimental or disproportionate treatment
predictive policing assessing risk of an individual committing a crime based solely on profiling
untargeted scraping of facial images to build facial recognition databases
inferring emotions in the workplace or educational institutions (save medical/safety)
biometric categorisation inferring sensitive attributes (race, political views, sexual orientation, etc.)
real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement (narrow exceptions)

annex_iii_categories.test: remote biometric identification, biometric categorisation, or emotion recognition (where not prohibited)
safety component in the management/operation of critical digital infrastructure, road traffic, or utilities
determining access, admission, evaluation of learning outcomes, or monitoring/detecting prohibited behaviour during tests
recruitment, screening, filtering applications, evaluating candidates, or decisions on promotion/termination/task allocation
eligibility for public assistance, creditworthiness/credit scoring, risk assessment & pricing in life/health insurance, or emergency dispatch
risk assessment of individuals, polygraphs, evidence reliability evaluation, or profiling in the course of detection/investigation
polygraphs, risk assessment, examination of asylum/visa/residence applications
assisting a judicial authority in researching/interpreting facts and law, or influencing election/referendum outcomes

annex_iii_exemption.test: system does NOT pose a significant risk of harm to health, safety or fundamental rights, e.g. performs a narrow procedural task, improves the result of a prior human activity, detects decision-making patterns without replacing human judgement, or performs preparatory work. Does NOT apply if the system profiles natural persons.
annex_iii_exemption.effect: May fall out of high-risk, but provider must document the assessment and register.

transparency_triggers.test: system interacts directly with natural persons (e.g. chatbot)
transparency_triggers.obligation: Inform the person they are interacting with AI, unless obvious.

transparency_triggers.test: generates synthetic audio, image, video or text content
transparency_triggers.obligation: Mark output as artificially generated/manipulated in a machine-readable way.

transparency_triggers.test: emotion recognition or biometric categorisation system
transparency_triggers.obligation: Inform exposed persons of the operation of the system.
Disclose that content has been artificially generated or manipulated.

base_obligations.obligation: Draw up and keep technical documentation of the model (training, testing, evaluation).
Provide information & documentation to downstream providers integrating the model.
Put in place a policy to comply with EU copyright law.
Publish a sufficiently detailed summary of training content.

systemic_risk.test: model trained with cumulative compute > 10^25 FLOPs, or designated by the Commission as having high-impact capabilities

extra_obligations.obligation: Perform model evaluation including adversarial testing.
Track, document and report serious incidents.
Ensure an adequate level of cybersecurity protection.

provider.obligation: Establish, implement and maintain a risk management system across the lifecycle.
Data governance: training/validation/test sets must be relevant, representative, and error-checked.
Draw up technical documentation before placing on market.
Automatic recording of events (logging) over the system lifetime.
Transparency and provision of instructions for use to deployers.
Ensure appropriate accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity.
Undergo conformity assessment and draw up an EU declaration of conformity; affix CE marking.
Register the system in the EU database before placing on market.

deployer.obligation: Use the system in accordance with the instructions for use.
Assign human oversight to competent, trained natural persons.
Ensure input data is relevant and sufficiently representative for the intended purpose.
Monitor operation and keep logs; inform provider/authority of risks or serious incidents.
Conduct a fundamental rights impact assessment (FRIA) where required (public bodies, certain services).

penalties.prohibited: Up to €35,000,000 or 7% of total worldwide annual turnover, whichever is higher.
penalties.most_obligations: Up to €15,000,000 or 3% of worldwide annual turnover.
penalties.incorrect_information: Up to €7,500,000 or 1% of worldwide annual turnover.
